01 / Overview

Project memory for coding agents

A tool for recovering the reasons behind previous work in a new session. Session-end and pre-compaction hooks queue conversations; a tray app uses the selected recording model to update topic-based memory documents.

02 / FEATURES

Features

01

Conversation to memory

Claude Code and Codex hooks add sessions to a processing queue. Recording resumes from the last saved position.

02

Files and search

Store Markdown in a folder you choose and index it with qmd. Later agents can retrieve relevant memory through qmd MCP.

03

Traceable sources

Follow links from memory documents to saved conversation copies and individual statements.

04

Review and sync

Compare changes and select documents to commit. Review source conversations and the final document when histories diverge between computers.

03 / INTERFACE

Inside the app

Select an image to view it at a larger size.

01 / 03

Check recording from the tray

See active tasks, queued or failed sessions, and recent activity. Tasks queued while the app is closed are processed when it starts again.

02 / 03

Review before sharing memory

Connect the same memory repository on multiple computers. When histories diverge, inspect source conversations and available choices, then preview the final document before applying changes.

03 / 03

Connect tools and a memory folder

The first-run guide helps prepare your AI tools, memory folder, and search integration. Revisit the settings to check or repair connections.

05 / FAQ

Questions

Built with
Tauri 2RustReactTypeScriptqmdGit
Can I install it now?＋

Lore is in development. Public installers and source code are not available yet.

Will every agent automatically use the memory?＋

Later agents also need qmd MCP and instructions to search for memory. Recording and retrieval are separate steps.

Where are conversations and memory stored?＋

Documents and source conversation copies are kept in your selected memory folder. Queues, settings, and search indexes are stored separately in each computer’s app data.

Is all processing local?＋

Files and indexes are stored locally, but conversations and memory needed for recording are sent to the model provider used by your selected CLI.
